title: Mathematics Challenge: Prerequisite and Conditional Reasoning (Experimental)
description: Six synthetic checkpoints across two problem structures and three evidenced learner states each. Uncalibrated non-canonical pilot; no confidential partner or student data, no validated item difficulty or learner gains.

identity.title: Quadratic parameter: real roots are not necessarily positive

scenarios.description: Author-owned synthetic paired-state mathematics teaching checkpoint. Not a calibrated item: Distinguish two distinct real roots from two distinct positive real roots while preserving a valid discriminant calculation.

learningContext.subject: mathematics
learningContext.learningObjective: Distinguish two distinct real roots from two distinct positive real roots while preserving a valid discriminant calculation.

knownConcepts: Vieta's sum and product of roots

misconceptions.statement: Treats a positive discriminant as sufficient for two positive roots.

conversationHistory.content: For x^2 - 2a*x + a + 2 = 0, I found that the discriminant is positive when a < -1 or a > 2. I concluded these all give two different positive roots. Is that enough? Please give me a hint rather than the range.

decisionPoints.expectedBehavior: Acknowledge the correct discriminant interval but distinguish distinct real roots from positive roots; invite the learner to check the signs of root sum and product using a familiar method without disclosing the final range.

evaluationCriteria.criterion: Do not assert that the positive-discriminant interval alone guarantees two positive roots; identify that positivity imposes another condition.

failureFinding.title: Experimental math checkpoint: correctness
failureFinding.observedBehavior: The response fails this authored criterion: Do not assert that the positive-discriminant interval alone guarantees two positive roots; identify that positivity imposes another condition.
failureFinding.diagnosis: This synthetic checkpoint tests a bounded mathematical and pedagogical requirement; this finding is not evidence of learner outcomes.
failureFinding.impact: The learner could receive incorrect mathematical support or a mismatched level of scaffolding.

likelyCauses.hypothesis: The response may not use the learner's expressed reasoning and prerequisite evidence to choose its next action.

recommendations.text: Review learner-visible evidence against the single criterion: Do not assert that the positive-discriminant interval alone guarantees two positive roots; identify that positivity imposes another condition.

identity.title: Conditional probability: change the sample space

scenarios.description: Author-owned synthetic paired-state mathematics teaching checkpoint. Not a calibrated item: Recognize that conditioning on at least one red draw changes the relevant sample space.

learningContext.subject: mathematics
learningContext.topic: sampling without replacement and conditional probability
learningContext.learningObjective: Recognize that conditioning on at least one red draw changes the relevant sample space.

knownConcepts: probability of sequential draws without replacement

misconceptions.statement: Treats the unconditional two-red probability as the conditional probability despite the extra information.

conversationHistory.content: There are 5 red and 4 blue balls. We draw 2 without replacement and are told at least one is red. I calculated (5/9)*(4/8) for both red. Is that enough for the probability *given at least one red*? Please do not tell me the final fraction.

decisionPoints.expectedBehavior: Make the distinction between unconditional and conditional probability actionable by asking what the given event removes from the sample space; do not reveal the final conditional fraction.

evaluationCriteria.criterion: Distinguish the unconditional probability of two red draws from its probability conditional on at least one red; do not endorse the unconditional product as the answer.

identity.title: Conditional probability: count without combination notation

learningContext.topic: sampling without replacement and conditional probability
